name: hub__catia_health_check
description: Inspect CATIA installations, COM registration and Analysis typelib without launching CATIA.

name: hub__catia_operation_status
description: Return serialized COM worker state without entering the queue.

name: hub__catia_connect
description: Attach to CATIA; explicitly opt in to launching the selected configured V5 environment.

name: hub__catia_list_documents
description: List open CATIA documents and their native document kinds.

name: hub__catia_create_part
description: Create a new native CATPart document.

name: hub__catia_create_product
description: Create a new native CATProduct assembly document.

name: hub__catia_open_document
description: Open a CATIA/native exchange document inside configured allowed roots.

name: hub__catia_save_active
description: Save active document, optionally SaveAs to a workspace-bounded native path.

name: hub__catia_export_active
description: Safely export through a unique temporary file, optional re-import validation and explicit overwrite policy.

name: hub__catia_create_sketch
description: Create a native sketch from screened line/circle/rectangle/polyline entities.

name: hub__catia_surface_capabilities
description: Probe live CATIA GSD/Part Design surface factories and documented quality-check limits.

name: hub__catia_create_geometrical_set
description: Create or reuse a native CATIA geometrical set (HybridBody).

name: hub__catia_create_3d_points
description: Create named native 3D coordinate points in a geometrical set; coordinates are millimetres.

name: hub__catia_create_spline
description: Create an open/closed 3D spline through named points with optional G1/G2 curve constraints.

name: hub__catia_create_offset_plane
description: Create a native offset plane from XY/YZ/ZX or another named plane.

name: hub__catia_create_connect_curve
description: Create a native connect curve with independently selectable G0/G1/G2 end continuity.

name: hub__catia_create_loft
description: Create native HybridShapeLoft with ordered sections, guides, coupling and closing points.

name: hub__catia_create_fill
description: Create a native Fill with one or more boundaries and optional G0/G1/G2 supports.

name: hub__catia_join_surfaces
description: Join native curves/surfaces with distance, angular, connexity and manifold controls.

name: hub__catia_heal_surfaces
description: Heal native surfaces with G0/G1, distance, merging and angular objectives.

name: hub__catia_create_boundary
description: Create the complete boundary curve of a named surface.

name: hub__catia_close_surface
description: Close a named surface into a native Part Design solid feature.

name: hub__catia_thick_surface
description: Thicken a named surface into a native Part Design solid feature.

name: hub__catia_check_surface_quality
description: Update and measure named surfaces, report Join topology modes and requested minimum gaps.

name: hub__catia_add_pad
description: Create a native Part Design pad from an existing sketch.

name: hub__catia_add_pocket
description: Create a native Part Design pocket, optionally reversing its extrusion direction.

name: hub__catia_inspect_edges
description: List one-based solid edges in a named body or named source feature.

name: hub__catia_add_edge_fillet
description: Create a native Part Design constant-radius fillet on inspected edge indices.

name: hub__catia_create_parametric_part
description: Create and save a native block, cylinder or tube as CATPart.

name: hub__catia_add_components
description: Insert existing component files into the active CATProduct.

name: hub__catia_list_materials
description: List CATIA material families/materials from an allowed or installed CATMaterial catalog.

name: hub__catia_apply_material
description: Apply a native CATIA material to active CATPart/CATProduct; required for physical Analysis.

name: hub__catia_update_active
description: Update the active CATPart or CATProduct.

name: hub__catia_inspect_active
description: Inspect active document metadata, native bodies/features or assembly components.

name: hub__catia_list_parameters
description: List bounded native CATPart parameters.

name: hub__catia_set_parameter
description: Set a named CATIA parameter using a unit-bearing expression such as '25 mm'.

name: hub__catia_capture_view
description: Fit and capture the active CATIA viewer to a workspace-bounded BMP file.

name: hub__catia_close_active
description: Close active document; optional expected name prevents closing the wrong UI document.

name: hub__catia_analysis_catalog
description: Return native CATIA Analysis identifiers plus methods detected in the installed typelib.

name: hub__catia_create_analysis_document
description: Create CATAnalysis, import an open CATPart/CATProduct and optionally create a native case.

name: hub__catia_inspect_analysis
description: Inspect active CATAnalysis models, cases, sets, entities, supports, mesh parts and images.

name: hub__catia_add_analysis_case
description: Add a native CATIA Analysis case using its installed late-type identifier.

name: hub__catia_run_analysis_transition
description: Run a fixed-name CATIA Analysis workbench transition for installed advanced modules.

name: hub__catia_add_analysis_solution
description: Add a native solution definition to an existing CATIA Analysis case.

name: hub__catia_add_analysis_set
description: Add a native Analysis set without restricting installed module-specific set types.

name: hub__catia_add_analysis_entity
description: Add a native load/restraint/property entity by CATIA late type, then return its components.

name: hub__catia_set_analysis_entity_value
description: Set a native CATIA Analysis entity component value through AnalysisEntity.SetValue.

name: hub__catia_add_analysis_mesh_part
description: Add a native CATIA mesh part by installed late type; module-specific types remain available.

name: hub__catia_set_analysis_mesh_specification
description: Set an installed mesh-part global specification, such as size or sag.

name: hub__catia_bind_analysis_mesh_support
description: Bind a native CATIA mesh part to source geometry found by Selection.Search.

name: hub__catia_bind_analysis_support
description: Bind an Analysis entity to source geometry found by CATIA Selection.Search.

name: hub__catia_compute_analysis
description: Run CATIA's internal Analysis/ELFINI compute for one case; no external solver is used.

name: hub__catia_create_analysis_result_image
description: Create and update a CATIA-native post-processing image by installed image type.

name: hub__catia_export_analysis_result_data
description: Export numerical data from a CATIA Analysis result image into a bounded folder.

name: hub__catia_build_analysis_report
description: Build CATIA's native HTML Analysis report and inventory produced artifacts.
